svg.text: Seen from Berlin. 14 PoPs, 21 multiplex sections, 132 fiber spans. Line colour is OSNR margin at DP-16QAM 64GBd 400G.
Generated from branch main. The number inside a site is its optical degree; dots along a route are span boundaries. Coastlines: Natural Earth.
